column1: # Geant4 11.4.3 datasets, the single source of truth for all three installers.
# Taken from the table geant4-config carries inside itself, which is the
# authority: it holds, per dataset, the environment variable, the installed
# directory, the archive name and the MD5 that `geant4-config --check-datasets`
# a Geant4 upgrade; do not edit the rows by hand.
# The archive name is NOT the directory name with a dot inserted.  Three of them
# carry a G4 prefix the directory does not (PhotonEvaporation, RadioactiveDecay,
# RealSurface), so deriving one from the other gives a URL that 404s.
# "required" marks the seven datasets Geant4 turns into a fatal exception the
# moment the physics tables are built: nothing runs without them.  It is shown
# to the user, not used to choose: every installer selects all the datasets by
# default, and the user can leave out any of them.
#   directory  variable  archive  md5  required  description
